# 1. Process Objective & Summary

The Stirred Tank Heater (STHR) regulates outlet liquid temperature ($T$) and liquid hold-up height ($H$) under inlet feed disturbances ($F_{in}, T_{in}$).

```{python}
#| label: sthr-parameters
#| caption: "Nominal System Parameters"
import pandas as pd

params = {
    "Parameter": ["Tank Diameter", "Level Setpoint", "Outlet Temp Setpoint", "Steam Heating Temp", "Overall Heat Transfer (UA)"],
    "Symbol": ["D", "H_sp", "T_sp", "T_steam", "UA"],
    "Value": [1.50, 2.00, 65.00, 140.00, 12.50],
    "Unit": ["m", "m", "°C", "°C", "kW/°C"]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(params)
print(df.to_markdown(index=False))
```

# 2. Dynamic Equations

## 2.1 Liquid Level Mass Balance
$$\frac{dH}{dt} = \frac{F_{in} - F_{out}}{A}$$

$$F_{out} = K_v \cdot V_o \cdot \sqrt{\rho g H}$$

## 2.2 Thermal Energy Balance
$$\rho C_p V \frac{dT}{dt} = \rho C_p F_{in} (T_{in} - T) + Q_{steam} - Q_{loss}$$

$$Q_{steam} = U A_s \cdot (T_{steam} - T) \cdot V_s$$

# 3. Python Simulation Step-Response

```{python}
#| label: sthr-simulation
#| fig-cap: "Open-Loop Thermal Response to Steam Valve Step Change"
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Time vector
t = np.linspace(0, 50, 500)
# Step response model: T(t) = T0 + K * (1 - exp(-t/tau))
T0 = 30.0
K = 35.0
tau = 8.5

T = T0 + K * (1 - np.exp(-t / tau))

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(t, T, color='#ffd600', linewidth=2, label='Tank Temp T(t)')
plt.axhline(65.0, color='#4caf50', linestyle='--', label='Setpoint T_sp')
plt.title('STHR Open-Loop Heating Dynamics', color='white')
plt.xlabel('Time (s)', color='white')
plt.ylabel('Temperature (°C)', color='white')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.2)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
